title: Vista Del Mare | KEY.co
description_expanded: Inside, the home unfolds like a well-curated gallery of modern living spaces. The ground floor hosts a queen-sized bedroom with an ensuite that boasts a separate tub and shower, alongside French doors that open to a private pool, offering a secluded oasis right at your doorstep. Ascend to the bustling second floor, where the energy shifts to vibrant family life, featuring two king bedrooms with balcony access and a bunk room designed as a youthful haven. The heart of the home on the third floor presents a breathtaking open-plan living, dining, and kitchen area, accented by an Italian marble island and elegant dining setup. For those seeking a true retreat, the top-floor master suite provides a luxurious sanctuary with mesmerizing gulf views, making every moment in Vista del Mare not just a stay, but an exquisite beachside living experience.
